statement: The survivor is Morgan Vale, a male Evacuee/Survivor who starts in evac shelter A-23 on spring day 61 at 8:00 AM in a new default world
The survivor carries a smartphone with a flashlight app that can be turned on and off, which is needed in dark places
The NPC Cleora Hong, a pizza delivery girl in the shelter, asks the survivor to retrieve her dog from a house not far away; the survivor accepted the job, and she has no equipment to share
The shelter basement holds a protein ration, a plastic tupperware, an emergency blanket and a jacket on the floor near the stairs, which the survivor picked up
The shelter ground floor has a cupboard holding about 20 small cardboard boxes of protein ration
A locker on the shelter's north side holds an emergency blanket and jacket, a lighter, sealed bottles of clean water, plastic utensils, a whistle and protein rations
A hostile group of zombies, fat zombies, a feral human and a feral cop stands outside the shelter's east door
The field outside the shelter's west door holds flint, rocks, a large rock and sticks, and murky water lies to the north
A long pointy stick can be crafted from one long stick plus a cutting tool in about a minute with a fabrication skill of 1; the survivor made and wielded one
Cooking and clay recipes such as baked potato, clay pot oven and clay pellet need a heat source such as a nearby fire; the survivor has no cooker yet
The survivor carries 6 clean water and 6 protein ration wrappers
The survivor is in forest west of evac shelter A-23, with the town Meddybemps to the east on the overmap
The plan is to find sustainable water and food and explore cautiously while avoiding the hostile group at the east door

note: Cleora has nothing to give, so the survivor decided to do without shared equipment
Opened the pickup menu at the cupboard to take the protein rations
Picked up water, rations and the lighter from the locker
Closed the east door and left through the west door to avoid the hostile group
Crafted and wielded the long pointy stick
